verdict.rationale: Project planning on boards is a fair axis for a code-hosting platform, so it applies, but the evidence contains no Bitbucket kanban board or column-based tracking. The only related material is a built-in UI for managing Jira issues, which is an integration with a separate Atlassian product. That is adjacent and earns no credit toward Bitbucket itself delivering kanban boards.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plan and track work on kanban boards with columns

citations.quote: Reduce context-switching by managing your Jira issues in Bitbucket with the built-in Jira UI.
